title_en: When LLMs Encounter Open-world Graph Learning: A Fresh View on Unlabeled Data Uncertainty
title_zh: 当 LLM 遇到开放世界图学习：对未标注数据不确定性的新视角

sentences.en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have driven a systematic shift in the graph ML com- munity through the adoption of text-attributed graphs (TAGs).
sentences.zh: 近来，大型语言模型（LLM）通过采用文本属性图（text-attributed graph，TAG）推动了图机器学习社区的系统性转变。

sentences.en: Although a variety of frameworks have been developed, most fail to properly ad- dress the challenge of data uncertainty in open- world environments.
sentences.zh: 尽管已经开发了多种框架，但大多数都未能恰当地应对开放世界环境中数据不确定性的挑战。

sentences.en: A representative source of such uncertainty is the limited availability of la- bels in large-scale datasets due to high annotation costs, where unlabeled nodes may belong to either known classes or novel, unknown classes.
sentences.zh: 这类不确定性的一类典型来源是：由于标注成本高昂，大规模数据集中的标签十分有限，未标注节点可能属于已知类别，也可能属于全新的未知类别。

sentences.en: While node-level out-of-distribution detection and con- ventional open-world graph learning attempt to tackle this problem, two core limitations remain: ① Insufficient methods — existing approaches typically optimize semantics or topology in isola- tion for unknown-class rejection, failing to effec- tively integrate textual and structural information in TAGs;
sentences.zh: 虽然节点级的分布外检测和常规的开放世界图学习试图解决这一问题，但仍存在两个核心局限：① 方法不足——现有方法通常单独优化语义或拓扑以实现未知类别拒绝，未能有效地整合 TAG 中的文本与结构信息；

sentences.en: ② Incomplete pipelines — most stud- ies conduct only idealized analyses, such as as- suming a predefined number of unknown classes, which restricts practical utility for model updates and long-term deployment.
sentences.zh: ② 流程不完整——大多数研究只进行理想化的分析，例如预先设定未知类别的数量，这限制了模型更新和长期部署的实际效用。

sentences.en: To overcome these issues, we introduce the Open-world Graph Assis- tant (OGA), an LLM-based framework.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些问题，我们引入了开放世界图助手（Open-world Graph Assistant，OGA），一个基于 LLM 的框架。

sentences.en: OGA first performs unknown-class rejection via adaptive la- bel traceability (ALT), harmoniously combining semantic and topological cues, and then applies the graph label annotator (GLA) for unknown- class annotation, allowing unlabeled nodes to con- tribute to model training.
sentences.zh: OGA 首先通过自适应标签可追溯性（adaptive label traceability，ALT）进行未知类别拒绝，将语义线索与拓扑线索和谐地结合起来；然后应用图标签标注器（graph label annotator，GLA）进行未知类别标注，使未标注节点能够为模型训练做出贡献。

sentences.en: In essence, OGA offers a new pipeline that fully automates the handling of unlabeled nodes in open-world environments, and we establish a systematic benchmark cover- ing four key aspects to validate its effectiveness and practicality through extensive experiments.
sentences.zh: 本质上，OGA 提供了一条新的流水线，能够全自动地处理开放世界环境中的未标注节点；我们还建立了一个涵盖四个关键方面的系统性基准，通过大量实验验证其有效性和实用性。

title_en: When Model Merging Breaks Routing: Training-Free Calibration for MoE
title_zh: 当模型合并破坏路由时：面向 MoE 的免训练校准

sentences.en: Model merging has emerged as a cost-effective approach for consolidating the capabilities of multiple LLMs without retraining.
sentences.zh: 模型合并已成为一种具有成本效益的方法，可以在不重新训练的情况下整合多个 LLM 的能力。

sentences.en: However, existing merging techniques, largely based on linear parameter arithmetic or optimization, struggle when applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的合并技术大多基于线性参数运算或优化，在应用于混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）架构时举步维艰。

sentences.en: We identify a critical failure mode in MoE merging, termed *routing breakdown*, in which the merged router fails to dispatch tokens to suitable experts.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出 MoE 合并中的一个关键失效模式，称为*路由崩溃*（routing breakdown），即合并后的路由器无法将 token 分发给合适的专家。

sentences.en: Routing breakdown stems from the sensitivity of the non-linear softmax and discrete Top-$k$ routing mechanisms to parameter perturbations from merging, a sensitivity further amplified by load-balancing constraints imposed during MoE pretraining.
sentences.zh: 路由崩溃源于非线性 softmax 和离散 Top-$k$ 路由机制对合并所带来参数扰动的敏感性，而这种敏感性又被 MoE 预训练期间施加的负载均衡约束进一步放大。

sentences.en: Because fine-tuned experts exhibit distinct specializations, even modest misrouting can cause severe performance degradation.
sentences.zh: 由于微调后的专家具有不同的专门化特长，即使是轻微的错误路由也会造成严重的性能退化。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose Hessian-Aware Router Calibration (HARC), a training-free framework that leverages second-order curvature information to realign the merged router.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了海森感知路由器校准（Hessian-Aware Router Calibration，HARC），一个利用二阶曲率信息重新对齐合并后路由器的免训练框架。

sentences.en: This approach admits a closed-form solution that can be efficiently solved using a matrix-free conjugate gradient method.
sentences.zh: 该方法具有闭式解，可以通过无矩阵共轭梯度法高效求解。

sentences.en: Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that HARC effectively mitigates routing breakdown across diverse MoE merging baselines and leads to substantial performance improvements.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上的实验表明，HARC 能有效缓解多种 MoE 合并基线下的路由崩溃，并带来显著的性能提升。

title_en: When More Data Doesn't Help: Limits of Adaptation in Multitask Learning
title_zh: 当更多数据不再起作用时：多任务学习中适应的极限

sentences.en: Multitask learning and related frameworks have achieved tremendous success in modern applications.
sentences.zh: 多任务学习及相关框架在现代应用中取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: In multitask learning problem, we are given a set of heterogeneous datasets collected from related source tasks and hope to enhance the performance above what we could hope to achieve by solving each of them individually.
sentences.zh: 在多任务学习问题中，我们拿到一组从相关源任务收集到的异质数据集，并期望能够提升性能，使其超过单独解决每个任务所能达到的水平。

sentences.en: The recent work of Hanneke & Kpotufe (2022) has showed that, without access to distributional information, no algorithm based on aggregating samples alone can guarantee optimal risk as long as the sample size per task is bounded.
sentences.zh: Hanneke & Kpotufe（2022）的近期工作表明，在无法获得分布信息的情况下，只要每个任务的样本量有界，任何仅基于聚合样本的算法都无法保证最优风险。

sentences.en: In this paper, we focus on understanding the statistical limits of multitask learning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们专注于理解多任务学习的统计极限。

sentences.en: We go beyond the no-free-lunch theorem in Hanneke & Kpotufe (2022) by establishing a stronger impossibility result of adaptation that holds for arbitrarily large sample size per task.
sentences.zh: 我们超越 Hanneke & Kpotufe（2022）中的免费午餐定理，建立了一个更强的适应不可能性结果，它适用于任意大的每任务样本量。

sentences.en: This improvement conveys an important message that the hardness of multitask learning cannot be overcame by having abundant data per task.
sentences.zh: 这一改进传达了一个重要消息：多任务学习的困难并不能通过拥有丰富的每任务数据来克服。

sentences.en: We also discuss the notion of optimal adaptivity that may be of future interests.
sentences.zh: 我们还讨论了未来可能引起兴趣的最优自适应性（optimal adaptivity）概念。

title_en: When More Experts Hurt: Underfitting in Multi-Expert Learning to Defer
title_zh: 当更多专家反而有害：多专家延迟学习中的欠拟合

sentences.en: Learning to Defer (L2D) enables a classifier to abstain from predictions and defer to an expert, and has recently been extended to multi-expert settings.
sentences.zh: 延迟学习（Learning to Defer，L2D）使分类器能够放弃预测并把问题交给专家，最近它已被扩展到多专家场景。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that multi-expert L2D is fundamentally more challenging than the single-expert case.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明多专家 L2D 从根本上比单专家情形更具挑战性。

sentences.en: With multiple experts, the classifier's underfitting becomes inherent, which seriously degrades prediction performance, whereas in the single-expert setting it arises only under specific conditions.
sentences.zh: 在多个专家的情况下，分类器的欠拟合是内在的，这会严重降低预测性能；而在单专家设置下，欠拟合只在特定条件下才会出现。

sentences.en: We theoretically reveal that this stems from an intrinsic expert identifiability issue: learning which expert to trust from a diverse pool, a problem absent in the single-expert case and renders existing underfitting remedies failed.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上揭示，这源于一个内在的专家可辨识性问题：从多样化的专家池中学习该信任哪位专家。这个问题在单专家情形中并不存在，并使现有的欠拟合补救措施失效。

sentences.en: To tackle this issue, we propose PiCCE (**Pi**ck the **C**onfident and **C**orrect **E**xpert), a surrogate-based method that adaptively identifies a reliable expert based on empirical evidence.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 PiCCE（**Pi**ck the **C**onfident and **C**orrect **E**xpert，挑选自信且正确的专家），一种基于代理（surrogate）的方法，它根据经验证据自适应地识别可靠的专家。

sentences.en: PiCCE effectively reduces multi-expert L2D to a single-expert–like learning problem, thereby resolving multi-expert underfitting.
sentences.zh: PiCCE 有效地将多专家 L2D 简化为一个类单专家的学习问题，从而解决了多专家欠拟合。

sentences.en: We further prove its statistical consistency and ability to recover class probabilities and expert accuracies.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明了它的统计一致性，以及恢复类别概率和专家准确率的能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse settings, including real-world expert scenarios, validate our theoretical results and demonstrate improved performance.
sentences.zh: 在多种设置（包括真实世界的专家场景）下的大量实验验证了我们的理论结果，并展示了性能的提升。

title_en: When Planning Fails Despite Correct Execution: On Epistemic Calibration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 当计划在执行正确的情况下仍然失败：论基于 LLM 的多智能体系统的认知校准

sentences.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems can fail even when planned actions are executed correctly because agents may misjudge their knowledge when evaluating plan feasibility, a phenomenon we term epistemic miscalibration in planning.
sentences.zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统即使在计划动作被正确执行时也可能失败，因为智能体在评估计划可行性时可能会误判自己的知识，我们将这一现象称为规划中的认知失校准（epistemic miscalibration）。

sentences.en: Unlike execution errors, epistemic miscalibration is latent during planning, as generated plans can remain self-consistent and executable without observable errors; the miscalibration is also dynamic, as new information can alter feasibility assessments, potentially obscuring past miscalibration signals and causing them to recur over time.
sentences.zh: 与执行错误不同，认知失校准在规划期间是潜在的，因为生成的计划可能在没有可观测错误的情况下保持自洽且可执行；失校准同时也是动态的，因为新信息可能改变可行性评估，从而可能掩盖以往的失校准信号，并使其随着时间的推移反复出现。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Epistemic Planning Calibration Agentic Workflow (EPC-AW), which assesses whether plans remain supported under varying information conditions rather than directly verifying feasibility.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了认知规划校准智能体工作流（Epistemic Planning Calibration Agentic Workflow，EPC-AW），它评估计划在不同信息条件下是否仍然得到支持，而不是直接验证可行性。

sentences.en: EPC-AW employs Information-consistency-based Plan Selection, selecting plans whose evaluations are stable across agents, together with Consistency-guided Epistemic State Refinement to adapt calibration over time by leveraging past discrepancies to guide future planning.
sentences.zh: EPC-AW 采用基于信息一致性的计划选择，挑选那些在不同智能体间评估稳定的计划；同时结合一致性引导的认知状态精修，利用过去的差异来指导未来的规划，从而随时间调整校准。

sentences.en: Experiments show that EPC-AW improves system-level success by an average of 9.75\%.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，EPC-AW 将系统级成功率平均提升了 9.75\%。

sentences.en: Code is available in the public repository (https://github.com/wzhSteve/EPC-AW).
sentences.zh: 代码可在公开仓库中获取（https://github.com/wzhSteve/EPC-AW）。

title_en: When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data
title_zh: 当偏好标签不足时：从真实数据对齐扩散模型

sentences.en: Preference alignment aims to guide generative models by learning from comparisons between preferred and non-preferred samples.
sentences.zh: 偏好对齐旨在通过从偏好样本与非偏好样本之间的比较中学习，来引导生成模型。

sentences.en: In practice, most existing approaches rely on preference pairs constructed from model-generated images.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，大多数现有方法依赖由模型生成图像构建的偏好对。

sentences.en: Such supervision is inherently relative and can be ambiguous when both samples exhibit artifacts or limited visual quality, making it difficult to infer what constitutes a truly desirable output.
sentences.zh: 这类监督本质上是相对的，当两个样本都表现出伪影或视觉质量有限时，可能会变得模糊，从而难以推断什么是真正合意的输出。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate whether real data can serve as an alternative source of supervision for preference alignment.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究真实数据能否作为偏好对齐的替代性监督来源。

sentences.en: We adopt a data-centric perspective and study a curation strategy that treats real images as reference points and constructs preference signals by contrasting them with generated or perturbed samples, without requiring manually annotated preference pairs.
sentences.zh: 我们采取以数据为中心的视角，研究一种整理策略：将真实图像作为参考点，通过将它们与生成或扰动样本进行对比来构建偏好信号，而无需人工标注的偏好对。

sentences.en: Through empirical analysis, we show that real-data-based supervision provides effective guidance for aligning diffusion models and achieves performance comparable to existing preference-based methods.
sentences.zh: 通过实证分析，我们表明基于真实数据的监督能为对齐扩散模型提供有效的指导，并达到与现有基于偏好的方法相当的性能。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that real data offers a practical and complementary source of supervision for preference alignment and highlight directions of label-efficient alignment strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，真实数据为偏好对齐提供了一种实用且互补的监督来源，并突出了标签高效对齐策略的方向。

sentences.en: Code and models are available at https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign.
sentences.zh: 代码和模型可在 https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign 获取。

title_en: When RAG Hurts: Diagnosing and Mitigating Attention Distraction in Retrieval-Augmented LVLMs
title_zh: 当 RAG 反而有害：诊断并缓解检索增强 LVLM 中的注意力分散

sentences.en: While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is one of the dominant paradigms for enhancing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on knowledge-based VQA tasks, recent work attributes RAG failures to insufficient attention towards the retrieved context, proposing to reduce the attention allocated to image tokens.
sentences.zh: 虽然检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation，RAG）是在基于知识的 VQA 任务上增强大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的主流范式之一，但近期工作将 RAG 的失败归因于对检索上下文关注不足，并提议减少分配给图像 token 的注意力。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify a distinct failure mode that previous study overlooked: Attention Distraction (AD).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别出以往研究忽视的一种独特失效模式：注意力分散（Attention Distraction，AD）。

sentences.en: When the retrieved context is sufficient (highly relevant or including the correct answer), the retrieved text suppresses the visual attention globally, and the attention on image tokens shifts away from question-relevant regions.
sentences.zh: 当检索到的上下文足够充分（高度相关或包含正确答案）时，检索文本会在全局上抑制视觉注意力，图像 token 上的注意力会从与问题相关的区域转移开来。

sentences.en: This leads to failures on questions the model could originally answer correctly without the retrieved text.
sentences.zh: 这会导致模型在那些原本无需检索文本就能正确回答的问题上失败。

sentences.en: To mitigate this issue, we propose MAD-RAG, a training-free intervention that decouples visual grounding from context integration through a dual-question formulation, combined with attention mixing to preserve image-conditioned evidence.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们提出了 MAD-RAG，一种免训练的干预方法，它通过双问题表述将视觉定位与上下文整合解耦，并结合注意力混合来保留以图像为条件的证据。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on OK-VQA, E-VQA, and InfoSeek demonstrate that MAD-RAG consistently outperforms existing baselines across different model families, yielding absolute gains of up to 4.76%, 9.20%, and 6.18% over the vanilla RAG baseline.
sentences.zh: 在 OK-VQA、E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上的大量实验表明，MAD-RAG 在不同模型家族上始终优于现有基线，与原始 RAG 基线相比取得了最高 4.76%、9.20% 和 6.18% 的绝对提升。

sentences.en: Notably, MAD-RAG rectifies up to 74.68% of failure cases with negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，MAD-RAG 以可忽略的计算开销纠正了高达 74.68% 的失败案例。

title_en: When Random Saliency Looks Trained: Architectural Center Bias in CNN Interpretability
title_zh: 当随机显著性看起来像训练过的：CNN 可解释性中的架构中心偏差

sentences.en: Saliency maps are widely used to interpret image classification models and build trust in their predictions; however, their reliability remains a central concern, as randomized networks can produce saliency maps that closely resemble those of trained models.
sentences.zh: 显著性图（saliency map）被广泛用于解释图像分类模型并建立对其预测的信任；然而，它们的可靠性仍然是一个核心关注点，因为随机化的网络可以产生与训练模型非常相似的显著性图。

sentences.en: We identify a previously underappreciated architectural contributor to this phenomenon: a *center-focused saliency bias* induced by common convolutional design choices.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出这一现象中一个此前被低估的架构因素：由常见卷积设计选择所诱发的*中心聚焦的显著性偏差*。

sentences.en: Through controlled ablations, we show that architectural components such as zero padding and receptive field growth induce a center-focused saliency prior that is already present in randomly initialized CNNs and under randomized inputs.
sentences.zh: 通过受控的消融实验，我们表明，诸如零填充和感受野增长之类的架构组件会诱发一种中心聚焦的显著性先验，这种先验在随机初始化的 CNN 中以及随机输入下已经存在。

sentences.en: In contrast, this behavior is largely absent in non-convolutional architectures such as Vision Transformers (ViTs) and multilayer perceptrons (MLPs).
sentences.zh: 相比之下，这种行为在诸如视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformer，ViT）和多层感知机（multilayer perceptron，MLP）之类的非卷积架构中基本不存在。

sentences.en: To investigate the interaction between architectural priors and learning, we introduce a corner-shift benchmark and a Center-Shift Index that quantify how saliency redistributes under object relocation.
sentences.zh: 为研究架构先验与学习之间的相互作用，我们引入了一个角点位移基准和一个中心位移指数（Center-Shift Index），用以量化对象位置移动时显著性的重新分布情况。

sentences.en: We show that training can partially shift saliency toward object regions, while randomized models remain dominated by architectural center bias, providing one mechanism by which trained-random similarity can be inflated and clarifying how architectural priors can confound standard saliency evaluations.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，训练可以将显著性部分地移向对象区域，而随机化模型仍以架构中心偏差为主。这提供了一种使得训练-随机相似性被夸大的机制，并阐明架构先验如何干扰标准的显著性评估。

title_en: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents
title_zh: 当重新规划成为瓶颈：面向具身智能体的预算化重新规划

sentences.en: Embodied agents replan frequently to recover from execution drift, partial observability, and coordination hazards, but each LLM-based replanning call can consume an accumulated textual context that grows over time and across agents.
sentences.zh: 具身智能体经常重新规划，以从执行漂移、部分可观测性和协调风险中恢复，但每一次基于 LLM 的重新规划调用都会消耗累积的文本上下文，而这种上下文会随时间并在多个智能体间不断增长。

sentences.en: Once this context becomes large, replanning latency develops heavy tails and can miss real-time deadlines even when task success remains high, a failure mode that is hard to detect from average latency or success alone.
sentences.zh: 一旦这种上下文变得很大，重新规划延迟就会出现厚重尾分布，甚至可能在任务成功率仍然很高时错过实时截止期限——这是一种仅从平均延迟或成功率难以察觉的失效模式。

sentences.en: We present BRACE, a controller that formulates replanning as a budgeted control loop by deciding whether to replan, selecting a replanning mode, and allocating an explicit token budget and latency service-level objective (SLO) while accounting for optional efficiency modules.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 BRACE，一个控制器，它将重新规划表述为一个预算化控制循环：决定是否重新规划、选择重新规划模式，并分配显式的 token 预算和延迟服务级目标（service-level objective，SLO），同时考虑可选的效率模块。

sentences.en: As a reusable component, we introduce E-RECAP, a cost-aware progressive token pruning method that predicts token utility and prunes replanning contexts across transformer layers while preserving critical head and tail tokens.
sentences.zh: 作为一个可复用组件，我们引入了 E-RECAP，一种成本感知的渐进式 token 剪枝方法，它预测 token 的效用，并在各 Transformer 层间剪枝重新规划上下文，同时保留关键的头部和尾部 token。

sentences.en: Across Meta Habitat, RoboFactory, and AirSim, BRACE with E-RECAP reduces replanning-call token counts by 62–92% and SLO violation rates from 85.5–100.0% to 4.7–50.0% in settings where task success is already saturated.
sentences.zh: 在 Meta Habitat、RoboFactory 和 AirSim 上，在任务成功率已饱和的设置中，BRACE 搭配 E-RECAP 将重新规划调用的 token 数量减少了 62–92%，并将 SLO 违规率从 85.5–100.0% 降至 4.7–50.0%。

sentences.en: In a harder RoboFactory setting where open-loop, frozen-plan, and No BRACE all fail, BRACE + E-RECAP reaches 80.0% success with 4.6% SLO violations, demonstrating that tail-aware per-call budgeting is effective across embodied platforms.
sentences.zh: 在一个更难的 RoboFactory 设置中（开环、冻结计划和未使用 BRACE 均告失败），BRACE + E-RECAP 达到了 80.0% 的成功率且 SLO 违规率仅为 4.6%，这表明感知尾分布的逐调用预算管理在多种具身平台上都是有效的。

title_en: When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training:  A Unified Training-Serving System
title_zh: 当强化学习遇见自适应投机训练：一个统一的训练-服务系统

sentences.en: Speculative decoding can significantly accelerate LLM serving, yet most deployments today disentangle speculator training from serving, treating speculator training as a standalone offline modeling problem.
sentences.zh: 投机解码可以显著加速 LLM 服务，然而如今大多数部署都将投机器（speculator）训练与服务相分离，把投机器训练当作一个独立的离线建模问题。

sentences.en: We show that this decoupled formulation introduces substantial deployment and adaptation lag: (1) high time-to-serve, since a speculator must be trained offline for a considerable period before deployment; (2) delayed utility feedback, since the true end-to-end decoding speedup is only known after training and cannot be inferred reliably from acceptance rate alone due to model-architecture, diverse prompt engineering, and system-level overheads; and (3) domain-drift degradation, as the target model is repurposed to new domains and the speculator becomes stale and less effective.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种解耦的表述会引入大量的部署与适应滞后：（1）服务时间很长——投机器必须先离线训练相当一段时间才能部署；（2）效用反馈延迟——真正的端到端解码加速只有在训练之后才知道，而且由于模型架构、多样的提示工程和系统级开销，仅凭接受率无法可靠地推断；（3）领域漂移导致性能下降——当目标模型被重新用于新领域时，投机器会变得过时且效果不佳。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we present Aurora, a unified training–serving system that closes the loop by continuously learning a speculator directly from live inference traces.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Aurora，一个统一的训练-服务系统，它通过直接从实时推理轨迹中持续学习投机器来闭合循环。

sentences.en: Aurora reframes online speculator learning as an asynchronous reinforcement-learning problem: accepted tokens provide positive feedback, while rejected speculator proposals provide implicit negative feedback that inherits the online traffic failure signals.
sentences.zh: Aurora 将在线投机器学习重新表述为一个异步强化学习问题：被接受的 token 提供正反馈，而被拒绝的投机器提案则提供隐式的负反馈，后者继承了在线流量的失败信号。

sentences.en: Our design integrates an SGLang-based inference server with an asynchronous training server, enabling hot-swapped speculator updates without service interruption.
sentences.zh: 我们的设计将基于 SGLang 的推理服务器与异步训练服务器集成在一起，支持热替换的投机器更新，而不会中断服务。

sentences.en: Crucially, Aurora supports day-0 deployment: a speculator can be served immediately and rapidly adapted to live traffic, improving system performance while providing immediate utility feedback.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，Aurora 支持第零天部署：投机器可以立即上线并快速适应实时流量，在改进系统性能的同时提供即时的效用反馈。

sentences.en: Across experiments, Aurora achieves a 1.5$\times$ day-0 speedup on recently released frontier models (e.g., MiniMax M2.1 229B and Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B).
sentences.zh: 在系列实验中，Aurora 在最近发布的尖端模型（例如 MiniMax M2.1 229B 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B）上实现了 1.5$\times$ 的第零天加速。

sentences.en: Aurora also adapts effectively to distribution shifts in user traffic, delivering an additional 1.25$\times$ speedup over a well-trained but static speculator on widely used models (e.g., Qwen3 and Llama3).
sentences.zh: Aurora 还能有效适应用户流量中的分布变化，在广泛使用的模型（例如 Qwen3 和 Llama3）上，与训练良好但静态的投机器相比，带来额外的 1.25$\times$ 加速。

title_en: When Sample Selection Bias Precipitates Model Collapse
title_zh: 当样本选择偏差引发模型崩塌

sentences.en: The proliferation of recursive training on synthetic data can alleviate data scarcity but risks model collapse, where repeated training erodes distributional tails and homogenizes outputs.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据上进行递归训练的普及可以缓解数据稀缺，但有引发模型崩塌的风险——反复训练会侵蚀分布尾并使输出同质化。

sentences.en: Data selection is widely viewed as a remedy, yet its reliability depends critically on the reference distribution used by the verifier.
sentences.zh: 数据选择被广泛视为一种补救措施，然而其可靠性关键取决于验证器所使用的参考分布。

sentences.en: We show that in low-resource verification regimes, where each verifier observes only a small, fragmented, and biased slice of the target manifold, selection itself becomes biased.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在低资源验证场景下——每个验证器只能观察到目标流形的一小片碎片化且有偏差的部分——选择本身也会变得有偏差。

sentences.en: This situation naturally arises in low-resource data silos such as healthcare consortia or proprietary financial institutions, where raw data cannot be pooled and local references are inherently incomplete.
sentences.zh: 这种情况自然出现在低资源的数据孤岛中，例如医疗联盟或专有金融机构，在那里原始数据无法汇总，本地参考本质上是不完整的。

sentences.en: As a result, selection preferentially retains samples aligned with the local manifold while pruning globally relevant tail modes, turning from a safeguard against collapse into a mechanism that precipitates it.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，选择会优先保留与本地流形一致的样本，同时剪除具有全局相关性的尾模式，从而从防止崩塌的保障转变为引发崩塌的机制。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that such siloed selection accelerates collapse and induces power-law diversity decay.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明，这种孤岛式选择会加速崩塌，并诱发幂律式的多样性衰减。

sentences.en: As an initial mitigation, we construct Wasserstein proxy references from multiple silos without sharing raw data.
sentences.zh: 作为一种初步的缓解措施，我们在不共享原始数据的情况下，从多个数据孤岛构建 Wasserstein 代理参考。

sentences.en: Empirical results confirm that local-reference selection fails on skewed distributions, whereas collaborative proxy references mitigate diversity degradation, suggesting that recursive synthetic-data pipelines require particular caution when real-data coverage is fragmented or scarce.
sentences.zh: 实证结果证实，本地参考选择在偏斜分布上会失败，而协作式代理参考能缓解多样性退化，这表明当真实数据覆盖面碎片化或稀缺时，递归合成数据流水线需要格外谨慎。

authors.name: Xinbao Qiao
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

title_en: When Search Goes Wrong: Red-Teaming Web-Augmented Large Language Models
title_zh: 当搜索出错时：对网络增强的大型语言模型进行红队测试

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been augmented with web search to overcome the limitations of the static knowledge boundary by accessing up-to-date information from the open Internet.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已被增强以支持网络搜索，通过从开放的互联网获取最新信息来克服静态知识边界的局限。

sentences.en: While this integration enhances model capability, it also introduces a distinct safety threat surface: the retrieval and citation process has the potential risk of exposing users to harmful or low-credibility web content.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种整合增强了模型能力，但它也引入了一个独特的安全威胁面：检索与引用过程存在让用户接触到有害或低可信度网络内容的潜在风险。

sentences.en: Existing red-teaming methods are largely designed for standalone LLMs as they primarily focus on unsafe generation, ignoring risks emerging from the complex search workflow.
sentences.zh: 现有的红队测试方法主要针对独立的 LLM 设计，因为它们主要关注不安全的生成，而忽视了从复杂搜索工作流中涌现的风险。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose CREST-Search, a pioneering red-teaming framework for LLMs with web search.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 CREST-Search，一个面向带有网络搜索的 LLM 的开创性红队测试框架。

sentences.en: The cornerstone of CREST-Search is three novel attack strategies that generate seemingly benign search queries yet induce unsafe citations.
sentences.zh: CREST-Search 的基石是三种新颖的攻击策略，它们生成看似良性的搜索查询却能诱导出不安全的引用。

sentences.en: It also employs an iterative in-context refinement mechanism to strengthen adversarial effectiveness under black-box constraints.
sentences.zh: 它还采用一种迭代的上下文内精修机制，以在黑盒约束下增强对抗有效性。

sentences.en: In addition, we construct a search-specific harmful dataset, WebSearch-Harm, which enables fine-tuning a specialized red-teaming model to improve query quality.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们构建了一个针对搜索的有害数据集 WebSearch-Harm，它可以对专门的红队测试模型进行微调，以提升查询质量。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that CREST-Search can effectively bypass safety filters and systematically expose vulnerabilities in web search-based LLM systems, underscoring the necessity of the development of robust search models.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，CREST-Search 能够有效绕过安全过滤器，并系统地暴露基于网络搜索的 LLM 系统中的漏洞，凸显了开发稳健搜索模型的必要性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: When Shared Knowledge Hurts: Spectral Over-Accumulation in Model Merging
title_zh: 当共享知识反而有害：模型合并中的谱过度累积

sentences.en: Model merging combines multiple fine-tuned models into a single model by $\textit{adding}$ their weight updates, providing a lightweight alternative to retraining.
sentences.zh: 模型合并通过 $\textit{adding}$ 多个微调模型的权重更新，将它们组合成一个模型，从而为重新训练提供了一种轻量级的替代方案。

sentences.en: Existing methods primarily target resolving conflicts between task updates, leaving the failure mode of over-counting shared knowledge unaddressed.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要针对解决任务更新之间的冲突，而没有处理重复计算（over-count）共享知识这一失效模式。

sentences.en: We show that when tasks share aligned spectral directions (i.e., overlapping singular vectors), a simple linear combination repeatedly accumulates these directions, inflating the singular values and biasing the merged model toward shared subspaces.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当任务共享对齐的谱方向（即重叠的奇异向量）时，简单的线性组合会反复累积这些方向，使奇异值膨胀，并使合并后的模型偏向共享子空间。

sentences.en: To mitigate this issue, we propose Singular Value Calibration (SVC), a training-free and data-free post-processing method that quantifies subspace overlap and rescales inflated singular values to restore a balanced spectrum.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们提出了奇异值校准（Singular Value Calibration，SVC），一种免训练、免数据后处理方法，它量化子空间重叠，并重新缩放膨胀的奇异值以恢复均衡的谱。

sentences.en: Across vision and language benchmarks, SVC consistently improves strong merging baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在视觉和语言基准上，SVC 持续改进了强大的合并基线，并达到了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by modifying only the singular values, SVC improves the performance of Task Arithmetic by 13.0\%.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过仅修改奇异值，SVC 将 Task Arithmetic 的性能提升了 13.0\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/lyymuwu/SVC.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/lyymuwu/SVC 获取。

title_en: When Simple Problems Wear Complex Costumes: Improving Efficiency in LRM's Adaptive Reasoning
title_zh: 当简单问题穿上复杂的外衣：提升大型推理模型自适应推理的效率

sentences.en: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated powerful multi-step problem-solving capabilities but often suffer from inefficiency due to an ``overthinking phenomenon", where they apply complex reasoning to simple tasks, resulting in unnecessary computational cost and latency.
sentences.zh: 最近的大型推理模型（Large Reasoning Model，LRM）展现了强大的多步问题求解能力，但常常因“过度思考现象”而效率低下——它们把复杂的推理应用到简单任务上，导致不必要的计算成本和延迟。

sentences.en: While adaptive reasoning models that can switch between generating explicit reasoning and producing direct answers offer a potential solution, their effectiveness is compromised by a critical flaw: they are often misled by superficial linguistic complexity, mistaking verbosely phrased simple problems for complex ones.
sentences.zh: 虽然能够在生成显式推理与给出直接答案之间切换的自适应推理模型提供了一种潜在解决方案，但它们的有效性受制于一个关键缺陷：它们常常被表面的语言复杂度误导，把措辞冗长的简单问题误认为复杂问题。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a two-stage training framework to create a more robust adaptive reasoner.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个两阶段训练框架，以创建更稳健的自适应推理器。

sentences.en: The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning with augmented data—presenting simple problems in both concise and redundant forms—to teach the model to ignore superficial verbosity.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段使用带增强数据的监督微调——以简洁和冗余两种形式呈现简单问题——来教会模型忽略表面的冗长。

sentences.en: Subsequently, a reinforcement learning phase utilizes Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a custom reward function to refine the model's adaptive policy, ensuring it selects a reasoning mode based on true task complexity rather than surface-level cues.
sentences.zh: 随后，强化学习阶段利用带有自定义奖励函数的组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO），来精修模型的自适应策略，确保它基于真实的任务复杂度而非表面线索来选择推理模式。

sentences.en: The resulting model reduces computational overhead without sacrificing accuracy and demonstrates improved robustness to misleading linguistic cues.
sentences.zh: 最终得到的模型在不牺牲准确率的情况下降低了计算开销，并对误导性的语言线索表现出更强的稳健性。

title_en: When Single Answer Is Not Enough: Rethinking Single-Step Retrosynthesis Benchmarks for LLMs
title_zh: 当单一答案不够时：重新思考面向 LLM 的单步逆合成基准

sentences.en: Recent progress has expanded the use of large language models (LLMs) in drug discovery, including synthesis planning.
sentences.zh: 近期的进展扩大了大型语言模型（LLM）在药物发现中的应用，包括合成规划。

sentences.en: However, objective evaluation of retrosynthesis performance remains limited.
sentences.zh: 然而，对逆合成性能的客观评估仍然有限。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks and metrics typically rely on published synthetic procedures and Top-K accuracy based on single ground-truth, which does not capture the open-ended nature of real-world synthesis planning.
sentences.zh: 现有的基准和指标通常依赖于已发表的合成流程和基于单一真实结果的 Top-K 准确率，而这无法捕捉现实世界中合成规划的开放性本质。

sentences.en: We propose a new benchmarking framework for single-step retrosynthesis that evaluates both general-purpose and chemistry-specialized LLMs using ChemCensor, a novel metric for chemical plausibility.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个新的单步逆合成基准框架，它使用 ChemCensor（一种用于化学合理性的新颖指标）来评估通用型与化学专用的 LLM。

sentences.en: By emphasizing plausibility over exact match, this approach better aligns with human synthesis planning practices.
sentences.zh: 通过强调合理性而非精确匹配，这一方法能更好地与人类的合成规划实践保持一致。

sentences.en: We also introduce CREED, a novel dataset comprising millions of ChemCensor-validated reaction records for LLM training, and use it to train a model that improves over the LLM baselines under this benchmark.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入了 CREED，一个新颖的数据集，包含数百万条经 ChemCensor 验证的反应记录，用于 LLM 训练；我们用它训练了一个模型，在该基准下取得了优于 LLM 基线的表现。

title_en: When Softmax Fails at the Top: Extreme‑Value Corrections for InfoNCE
title_zh: 当 Softmax 在顶端失效时：针对 InfoNCE 的极值修正

sentences.en: InfoNCE is the standard contrastive learning objective, but its softmax form is not only a computational convenience: it also encodes a statistical assumption about how the top-scoring example is selected.
sentences.zh: InfoNCE 是标准的对比学习目标，但它的 softmax 形式不仅是一种计算上的便利：它还编码了一个关于最高分样本如何被选中的统计假设。

sentences.en: Using extreme value theory, we show that this assumption is often misaligned with the normalized embedding setting used in modern contrastive learning.
sentences.zh: 利用极值理论，我们表明，这一假设常常与现代对比学习中所使用的归一化嵌入设置不一致。

sentences.en: Motivated by this mismatch, we propose \textsc{WEINCE}, a simple modification of InfoNCE that uses anchor-wise online batch statistics to blend the usual softmax logits with an endpoint shortfall correction, adding no trainable parameters.
sentences.zh: 受这一失配的启发，我们提出了 \textsc{WEINCE}，一种对 InfoNCE 的简单修改，它利用逐锚点的在线批次统计，将通常的 softmax logits 与端点短缺修正（endpoint shortfall correction）混合，且不增加任何可训练参数。

sentences.en: Across five vision benchmarks, \textsc{WEINCE} yields consistent improvements in frozen-feature evaluation.
sentences.zh: 在五个视觉基准上，\textsc{WEINCE} 在冻结特征评估中取得了一致的改进。

sentences.en: These results show that a more faithful statistical treatment of hard negatives can improve contrastive objectives.\footnote{Code: \href{https://github.com/hsme98/weince}{github.com/hsme98/weince}.}
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，对难负样本进行更符合实际的统计处理可以改进对比目标。\footnote{Code: \href{https://github.com/hsme98/weince}{github.com/hsme98/weince}.}

title_en: When Tabular Foundation Models Meet Strategic Tabular Data: A Prior Alignment Approach
title_zh: 当表格基础模型遇见策略性表格数据：一种先验对齐方法

sentences.en: Tabular foundation models based on pretrained prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have shown strong generalization on diverse tabular tasks, but they are typically designed for non-strategic settings where data distributions are independent of deployed classifiers.
sentences.zh: 基于预训练先验数据拟合网络（prior-data fitted network，PFN）的表格基础模型在多种表格任务上展现出强大的泛化能力，但它们通常是为非策略性场景设计的——在这些场景中，数据分布与已部署的分类器无关。

sentences.en: In many real-world decision scenarios, however, individuals may strategically modify their features after deployment to obtain favorable outcomes, inducing a post-deployment distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多现实世界的决策场景中，个体可能在部署之后策略性地修改其特征以获得有利的结果，从而引发部署后的分布偏移。

sentences.en: This paper studies whether PFN-style tabular foundation models can generalize to such strategic tabular data.
sentences.zh: 本文研究 PFN 风格的表格基础模型能否泛化到这类策略性表格数据。

sentences.en: We show that strategic manipulation creates a fundamental mismatch between the non-strategic prior learned during pretraining and the post-manipulation strategic prior encountered at deployment, which leads to an irreducible structural prediction bias.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，策略性操纵会在预训练期间学到的非策略性先验与部署时遇到的操纵后策略性先验之间造成根本性的失配，从而导致一种无法消除的结构性预测偏差。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose the Strategic Prior-data Fitted Network (SPN), an inference-time strategy-aware framework that adapts tabular foundation models to strategic environments without retraining or architectural modification.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了策略性先验数据拟合网络（Strategic Prior-data Fitted Network，SPN），一个推理时的策略感知框架，它无需重新训练或修改架构即可将表格基础模型适配到策略性环境中。

sentences.en: SPN constructs strategic in-context examples to approximate post-manipulation inputs and aligns PFN predictions with the induced strategic distribution via in-context learning, with theoretical guarantees on bias reduction.
sentences.zh: SPN 构建策略性的上下文内示例来逼近操纵后的输入，并通过上下文内学习将 PFN 的预测与由此诱发的策略性分布对齐，同时在偏差降低方面提供了理论保证。

sentences.en: Experiments on real-world and synthetic tabular datasets show that SPN consistently improves robustness and predictive performance under strategic manipulation compared with both tabular foundation models and classical tabular methods.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界和合成的表格数据集上的实验表明，与表格基础模型和经典表格方法相比，SPN 在策略性操纵下持续提升了鲁棒性和预测性能。

title_en: When the Prompt Becomes Visual: Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attacks for Large Image Editing Models
title_zh: 当提示变成视觉时：针对大型图像编辑模型的视觉中心越狱攻击

sentences.en: Recent advances in large image editing models have shifted the paradigm from text-driven instructions to vision-prompt editing, where user intent is inferred directly from visual inputs such as marks, arrows, and visual–text prompts.
sentences.zh: 大型图像编辑模型的最新进展已将范式从文本驱动指令转向视觉提示编辑，在这种范式中，用户意图直接从诸如标记、箭头和视觉-文本提示之类的视觉输入中推断。

sentences.en: While this paradigm greatly expands usability, it also introduces a critical and underexplored safety risk: the attack surface itself becomes visual.
sentences.zh: 虽然这一范式极大地扩展了可用性，但它也引入了一个关键且尚未充分探索的安全风险：攻击面本身变成了视觉的。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack (VJA), the first visual-to-visual jailbreak attack that conveys malicious instructions purely through visual inputs.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了视觉中心越狱攻击（Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack，VJA），这是第一种纯通过视觉输入传递恶意指令的视觉间越狱攻击。

sentences.en: To systematically study this emerging threat, we introduce IESBench, a safety-oriented benchmark for image editing models.
sentences.zh: 为系统地研究这一新兴威胁，我们引入了 IESBench，一个面向图像编辑模型的安全性基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on IESBench demonstrate that VJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art commercial models, achieving attack success rates of up to 80.9% on Nano Banana Pro and 70.1% on GPT-Image-1.5. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a training-free defense based on introspective multimodal reasoning, which substantially improves the safety of poorly aligned models to a level comparable with commercial systems, without auxiliary guard models and with negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 IESBench 上的大量实验表明，VJA 能有效突破最先进的商用模型，在 Nano Banana Pro 上取得了最高 80.9% 的攻击成功率，在 GPT-Image-1.5 上为 70.1%。为缓解这一漏洞，我们提出了一种基于内省式多模态推理的免训练防御，它能将对齐不佳的模型的安全性大幅提升到与商用系统相当的水平，无需辅助护栏模型，计算开销也可忽略不计。

sentences.en: Our findings expose new vulnerabilities, provide both a benchmark and practical defense to advance safe and trustworthy modern image editing systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现暴露了新的漏洞，提供了基准和实用防御，以推动现代图像编辑系统走向安全可信。

title_en: When to Memorize and When to Stop: Gated Recurrent Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
title_zh: 何时记忆、何时停止：面向长上下文推理的门控循环记忆

sentences.en: While reasoning over long context is crucial for various real-world applications, it remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) as they suffer from performance degradation as the context length grows.
sentences.zh: 虽然长上下文推理对多种现实应用至关重要，但对大型语言模型（LLM）来说仍然具有挑战性，因为它们会随着上下文长度的增长而出现性能退化。

sentences.en: Recent work MemAgent has tried to tackle this by processing context chunk-by-chunk in an RNN-like loop and updating a textual memory for final answering.
sentences.zh: 近期工作 MemAgent 尝试通过以类似 RNN 的循环逐块处理上下文、并更新文本记忆以用于最终回答来应对这一问题。

sentences.en: However, this naive recurrent memory update faces two crucial drawbacks:  (i) memory can quickly explode because it can update indiscriminately, even on evidence-free chunks;  and (ii) the loop lacks an exit mechanism, leading to unnecessary computation after even sufficient evidence is collected.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种朴素的循环记忆更新面临两个关键缺陷：（i）记忆可能迅速膨胀，因为即使是在没有证据的块上，它也会不加区分地更新；（ii）循环缺乏退出机制，即使在足够的证据已被收集之后，仍会导致不必要的计算。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose GRU-Mem, which incorporates two text-controlled gates for more stable and efficient long-context reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 GRU-Mem，它引入两个由文本控制的门，以实现更稳定、更高效的长上下文推理。

sentences.en: Specifically, in GRU-Mem, the memory only updates when the update gate is open and the recurrent loop will exit immediately once the exit gate is open.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在 GRU-Mem 中，只有当更新门开启时记忆才会更新，而一旦退出门开启，循环就会立即退出。

sentences.en: To endow the model with such capabilities, we introduce two reward signals $r^{\text{update}}$ and $r^{\text{exit}}$ within end-to-end RL, rewarding the correct updating and exiting behaviors respectively.
sentences.zh: 为使模型具备这些能力，我们在端到端 RL 中引入了两个奖励信号 $r^{\text{update}}$ 和 $r^{\text{exit}}$，分别奖励正确的更新行为和退出行为。

sentences.en: Experiments on various long-context reasoning tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of GRU-Mem, which generally outperforms the vanilla MemAgent with up to 400\% times inference speed acceleration.
sentences.zh: 在多种长上下文推理任务上的实验证明了 GRU-Mem 的有效性和高效性，它通常优于原始 MemAgent，推理速度最高可加速 400\% 倍。

title_en: When to Think, When to Speak:  Learning Disclosure Policies for LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 何时思考、何时开口：学习 LLM 推理的披露策略

sentences.en: In single-stream autoregressive interfaces, the same tokens both update the model state and constitute an irreversible public commitment.
sentences.zh: 在单流自回归接口中，相同的 token 既更新模型状态，又构成一种不可逆的公开承诺。

sentences.en: This coupling creates a \emph{silence tax}: additional deliberation postpones the first \emph{task-relevant} content, while naive early streaming risks premature commitments that bias subsequent generations.
sentences.zh: 这种耦合造成了一种 \emph{沉默税}（silence tax）：更多的深思熟虑会推迟首个\emph{与任务相关}的内容的出现，而天真的早期流式输出则冒着过早承诺的风险，从而使后续生成产生偏差。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{\emph{Side-by-Side (SxS)}} Interleaved Reasoning, which makes \emph{disclosure timing} a controllable decision within standard autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了\textbf{\emph{Side-by-Side（SxS）}}交错推理（Interleaved Reasoning），它使\emph{披露时机}成为标准自回归生成中一个可控的决策。

sentences.en: SxS interleaves partial disclosures with continued private reasoning in the same context, but releases content only when it is \emph{supported} by the reasoning so far.
sentences.zh: SxS 在同一上下文中将部分披露与持续的私有推理交错进行，但只有当前推理\emph{支持}的内容才会被释放。

sentences.en: To learn such pacing without incentivizing filler, we construct entailment-aligned interleaved trajectories by matching answer prefixes to supporting reasoning prefixes, then train with SFT to acquire the dual-action semantics and RL to recover reasoning performance under the new format.
sentences.zh: 为了在不去鼓励填充内容的情况下学习这种节奏，我们通过将答案前缀与支持的推理前缀相匹配，构建了与蕴含对齐的交错轨迹；然后用 SFT 训练以获得双动作语义，用 RL 恢复在新格式下的推理性能。

sentences.en: Across two Qwen3 architectures/scales (MoE \textbf{Qwen3-30B-A3B}, dense \textbf{Qwen3-4B}) and both in-domain (AIME25) and out-of-domain (GPQA-Diamond) benchmarks, SxS improves accuracy--\emph{content-latency} Pareto trade-offs under token-level proxies (e.g., inter-update waiting).
sentences.zh: 在两种 Qwen3 架构/规格（MoE \textbf{Qwen3-30B-A3B}、稠密 \textbf{Qwen3-4B}）以及域内（AIME25）和域外（GPQA-Diamond）基准上，SxS 在 token 级代理指标（例如更新间隔等待）下改善了准确率--\emph{内容-延迟}的 Pareto 权衡。

title_en: When to Trust the Cheap Check: Weak and Strong Verification for Reasoning
title_zh: 何时信任廉价检查：面向推理的弱验证与强验证

sentences.en: Reasoning with LLMs increasingly unfolds inside a broader verification loop.
sentences.zh: LLM 的推理越来越多地在更广泛的验证循环中展开。

sentences.en: Internally, systems use cheap checks, such as self-consistency or proxy rewards, which we call **weak verification**.
sentences.zh: 在内部，系统使用诸如自一致性或代理奖励之类的廉价检查，我们称之为**弱验证**。

sentences.en: Externally, users inspect outputs and steer the model through feedback until results are trustworthy, which we call **strong verification**.
sentences.zh: 在外部，用户检查输出，并通过反馈引导模型，直到结果可信，我们称之为**强验证**。

sentences.en: These signals differ sharply in cost and reliability: strong verification can establish trust but is resource-intensive, while weak verification is fast and scalable but noisy and imperfect.
sentences.zh: 这些信号在成本和可靠性上差异显著：强验证能够建立信任，但资源密集；而弱验证快速、可扩展，但有噪声且不完美。

sentences.en: We formalize this tension through **weak-strong verification policies**, which decide when to accept or reject based on weak verification and when to defer to strong verification.
sentences.zh: 我们通过**弱-强验证策略**形式化这一张力，该策略决定何时基于弱验证接受或拒绝，以及何时交由强验证处理。

sentences.en: We introduce metrics capturing incorrect acceptance, incorrect rejection, and strong-verification frequency.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一些指标，用以刻画错误接受、错误拒绝和强验证频率。

sentences.en: Over population, we show that optimal policies admit a two-threshold structure and that **calibration** and **sharpness** govern the value of weak verifiers.
sentences.zh: 在总体层面，我们表明最优策略具有双阈值结构，并且**校准**（calibration）和**锐度**（sharpness）决定了弱验证器的价值。

sentences.en: Building on this, we develop an online algorithm that provably controls acceptance and rejection errors without assumptions on the query stream, the language model, or the weak verifier.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们开发了一种在线算法，它能够在不对查询流、语言模型或弱验证器作任何假设的情况下，可证明地控制接受错误和拒绝错误。

sentences.en: Experiments on mathematical reasoning and sequential decision-making demonstrate that our algorithm achieves reliability comparable to exhaustive strong verification while significantly reducing verification cost.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理和序列决策上的实验表明，我们的算法达到了与穷举式强验证相当的可靠性，同时显著降低了验证成本。

title_en: Where Concept Erasure Should Occur: Concept–Layer Alignment in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
title_zh: 概念擦除应发生在何处：文生视频扩散模型中的概念-层对齐

sentences.en: Text-to-video diffusion transformers encode semantic information unevenly across model depth, which constrains effective concept erasure.
sentences.zh: 文生视频扩散 Transformer 在模型深度上不均匀地编码语义信息，这限制了有效的概念擦除。

sentences.en: We identify a representational bottleneck, termed concept–layer topological alignment, under which target concepts exhibit higher separability at certain representational depths.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一个表示瓶颈，称为概念-层拓扑对齐（concept–layer topological alignment），在该条件下，目标概念在特定的表示深度上表现出更高的可分离性。

sentences.en: Outside these depths, concept and non-target signals remain strongly entangled, limiting the effectiveness of depth-specific erasure.
sentences.zh: 在这些深度之外，概念与非目标信号仍然强烈纠缠，从而限制了针对特定深度的擦除的有效性。

sentences.en: This observation reframes concept erasure as the problem of identifying representational depths where concept–non-target separation naturally emerges.
sentences.zh: 这一观察将概念擦除重新表述为这样一个问题：找出概念-非目标分离自然出现的表示深度。

sentences.en: Motivated by this structural constraint, we introduce CLEAR, a separability-driven optimization framework for concept erasure that explicitly enforces concept–layer alignment.
sentences.zh: 受这一结构性约束的启发，我们引入了 CLEAR，一个由可分离性驱动的概念擦除优化框架，它显式地强制实现概念-层对齐。

sentences.en: CLEAR operationalizes this principle by formulating layer selection as an optimization problem over concept–non-target separability, rather than relying on layer-agnostic or heuristic choices.
sentences.zh: CLEAR 将这一原则付诸实践，把层选择表述为关于概念-非目标可分离性的优化问题，而不是依赖与层无关的或启发式的选择。

sentences.en: To enable this, we introduce a separability-aware objective that favors layers exhibiting stronger concept–non-target separation.
sentences.zh: 为使其可行，我们引入了一个感知可分离性的目标，它偏好那些表现出更强概念-非目标分离的层。

sentences.en: Experiments on large-scale text-to-video diffusion models demonstrate that enforcing concept--layer alignment leads to more precise concept suppression while preserving overall generative quality.
sentences.zh: 在大规模文生视频扩散模型上的实验表明，强制实施概念-层对齐能够实现更精确的概念抑制，同时保持整体的生成质量。

title_en: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
title_zh: 检测器在哪里失败：探索生成空间以实现可泛化的 AI 生成图像检测

sentences.en: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators.
sentences.zh: 检测 AI 生成图像（AI-generated image，AIGI）仍然具有挑战性，因为检测器往往无法泛化到未见过的生成器。

sentences.en: Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有方法在大数据集上训练，但当生成设置改变时，它们的性能仍然会下降，这表明仅靠数据规模是不够的，训练期间对生成变体的覆盖有限是一个关键因素。

sentences.en: Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling.
sentences.zh: 关于生成模型编辑的研究表明，内部表示的细微改变可以产生多样而有意义的图像变体，其中许多在标准采样下并未被探索。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们提出了 PROBE（Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration，通过边界探索探测鲁棒性），一个通过主动探索生成过程中具有挑战性的区域来改进检测器泛化能力的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify.
sentences.zh: PROBE 不把生成器当作固定的数据源，而是将检测器用作评论家（critic），通过流形级修改来引导生成器，从而产生难以分类的逼真样本。

sentences.en: These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector.
sentences.zh: 这些样本暴露了在标准数据采样策略下不常见的失败案例，并用于精修检测器。

sentences.en: Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的实验结果表明，PROBE 增强了对未见生成器的泛化能力，从而带来更具泛化性的 AIGI 检测性能。

title_en: Where Rectified Flows Leak: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
title_zh: 校正流在哪里泄露：刻画沿插值路径的成员信号

sentences.en: Understanding what generative models retain from training data remains challenging, with implications for copyright and privacy.
sentences.zh: 理解生成模型从训练数据中保留了什么仍然具有挑战性，这对版权和隐私都有影响。

sentences.en: Beyond verbatim reproduction, models can encode subtler traces of their training data that never surface in their outputs yet remain exploitable.
sentences.zh: 除了逐字再现之外，模型还可以编码训练数据中更细微的痕迹，这些痕迹从不显现在输出中，却仍然可以被利用。

sentences.en: We study this regime for Rectified Flows, which are increasingly used in deployed generative systems.
sentences.zh: 我们针对校正流（Rectified Flow）研究这一情形，校正流正越来越多地被用于已部署的生成系统中。

sentences.en: We analyse the interpolation path $X_\lambda = (1-\lambda)X_0 + \lambda X_1$ that defines the Rectified Flow training.
sentences.zh: 我们分析了定义校正流训练的插值路径 $X_\lambda = (1-\lambda)X_0 + \lambda X_1$。

sentences.en: We show that a gap exists between the reconstruction of train and test data that follows a bell-shaped curve over $\lambda$, wich accumulates during training, while the validation metrics remain stable.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，训练数据与测试数据的重建之间存在一个差距，它随 $\lambda$ 呈钟形曲线，并随训练而累积，而验证指标保持稳定。

sentences.en: The signal has a maximum whose location we derive in closed form under Gaussian assumptions.
sentences.zh: 该信号有一个最大值，我们在高斯假设下以闭式推导出了它的位置。

sentences.en: We validate these predictions on both audio and images and show that the bell-shaped structure is universal, while the peak prediction holds when our assumptions are satisfied.
sentences.zh: 我们在音频和图像上都验证了这些预测，并表明钟形结构具有普遍性，而当我们的假设得到满足时，峰值预测也成立。

sentences.en: As a proof of concept, we exploit this specific $\lambda$-resolved structure to perform a Membership Inference Attack, distinguishing members of the training set from non-members.
sentences.zh: 作为概念验证，我们利用这种特定的、按 $\lambda$ 解析的结构执行成员推断攻击，区分训练集的成员与非成员。

title_en: Which Algorithms Can Graph Neural Networks Learn?
title_zh: 图神经网络能学习哪些算法？

sentences.en: In recent years, there has been growing interest in understanding neural architectures' ability to learn to execute discrete algorithms, a line of work often referred to as neural algorithmic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 近年来，人们越来越关注理解神经架构学习执行离散算法的能力，这一研究方向通常被称为神经算法推理（neural algorithmic reasoning）。

sentences.en: The goal is to integrate algorithmic reasoning capabilities into larger neural pipelines.
sentences.zh: 其目标是将算法推理能力整合到更大的神经流水线中。

sentences.en: Many such architectures are based on (message-passing) graph neural networks (MPNNs), owing to their permutation equivariance and ability to deal with sparsity and variable-sized inputs.
sentences.zh: 许多这类架构都基于（消息传递）图神经网络（message-passing graph neural network，MPNN），因为它们具有置换等变性，并且能够处理稀疏输入和可变大小的输入。

sentences.en: However, existing work is either largely empirical and lacks formal guarantees or it focuses solely on expressivity, leaving open the question of when and how such architectures generalize beyond a finite training set.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有工作要么在很大程度上是经验性的、缺乏形式化保证，要么只关注表达能力，从而留下了这样的开放问题：这类架构何时以及如何泛化到有限的训练集之外。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a general theoretical framework that characterizes the necessary conditions under which MPNNs can learn an algorithm from a training set of small instances and provably approximate its behavior on inputs of arbitrary size.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个通用的理论框架，它刻画了 MPNN 能够从一个小规模实例的训练集中学习某个算法、并在任意大小的输入上可证明地逼近其行为所必需的条件。

sentences.en: Our framework applies to a broad class of algorithms, including single-source shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, and general dynamic programming problems, such as the $0$-$1$ knapsack problem.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架适用于一大类算法，包括单源最短路径、最小生成树，以及诸如 $0$-$1$ 背包问题之类的通用动态规划问题。

sentences.en: In addition, we establish impossibility results for a wide range of algorithmic tasks, showing that standard MPNN cannot compute them.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们对广泛的算法任务建立了不可能性结果，表明标准 MPNN 无法计算它们。

sentences.en: We derive more expressive MPNN-like architectures that overcome these limitations.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出更具表达能力、能克服这些局限的类 MPNN 架构。

sentences.en: Finally, we refine our analysis for the Bellman–Ford algorithm, yielding substantially smaller required training sets and significantly extending the recent work of Nerem et al., 2025 by allowing for a differentiable regularization loss.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们细化了针对 Bellman–Ford 算法的分析，所需训练集的规模大幅缩小，并通过允许使用可微正则化损失，显著扩展了 Nerem et al. 2025 的近作。

sentences.en: Empirical results largely support our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 实证结果在很大程度上支持了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Which Heads Matter for Reasoning? RL-Guided KV Cache Compression
title_zh: 哪些注意力头对推理重要？RL 引导的 KV 缓存压缩

sentences.en: Reasoning large language models exhibit complex reasoning behaviors via extended chain-of-thought generation that are highly fragile to information loss during decoding, creating critical challenges for KV cache compression.
sentences.zh: 推理型大型语言模型通过扩展的思维链生成表现出复杂的推理行为，这些行为在解码过程中对信息丢失高度敏感，从而给 KV 缓存压缩带来了严峻挑战。

sentences.en: Existing token-dropping methods directly disrupt reasoning chains by removing intermediate steps, while head-reallocation methods, designed for retrieval tasks, fail to preserve the heads essential for generative reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有的 token 丢弃方法通过移除中间步骤直接破坏推理链，而针对检索任务设计的头部重分配方法则无法保留对生成式推理至关重要的注意力头。

sentences.en: However, no existing method can identify which attention heads genuinely maintain reasoning consistency and control generation termination.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法都无法识别出哪些注意力头真正维持推理一致性并控制生成终止。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose RLKV, which uses reinforcement learning as a probe to discover which heads contribute to reasoning quality by directly optimizing their cache usage against actual generation outcomes.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RLKV，它把强化学习用作探针，通过直接针对实际生成结果优化各个注意力头的缓存使用，来发现哪些注意力头有助于推理质量。

sentences.en: This discovery naturally leads to an efficient compression strategy: we allocate full KV cache to reasoning-critical heads while aggressively compressing others with constant-size KV cache.
sentences.zh: 这一发现自然引出一个高效的压缩策略：我们为对推理关键的注意力头分配完整的 KV 缓存，同时用固定大小的 KV 缓存对其他注意力头进行大幅压缩。

sentences.en: Experiments reveal that a fraction of heads proves essential for reasoning, enabling 20--60% cache reduction with near-lossless performance across diverse tasks and models, and up to 2.06x end-to-end speedup at 60% reduction.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，一小部分注意力头对推理至关重要，这使得缓存减少 20–60% 而性能几乎无损，适用于多种任务和模型；在 60% 的压缩率下，端到端速度最高提升 2.06 倍。

title_en: WhisperSplat: Lossless Steganography in 3D Gaussian Splatting
title_zh: WhisperSplat：3D 高斯泼溅中的无损隐写

sentences.en: We present WhisperSplat, the first lossless steganography method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models that hides a full‐resolution 2D image in a single view without any degradation of the model's rendering quality elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 WhisperSplat，这是首个针对 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting，3DGS）模型的无损隐写方法，它能在不损害模型其他任何地方的渲染质量的情况下，将一张全分辨率的 2D 图像隐藏到单个视角中。

sentences.en: Prior work embeds data by retraining or modifying model weights, altering novel‐view synthesis fidelity and limiting capacity.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作通过重新训练或修改模型权重来嵌入数据，这会改变新视角合成的保真度并限制容量。

sentences.en: Instead, we learn a small, view‐specific noise key applied to each Gaussian's spherical‐harmonic (SH) features while keeping all other views remain indistinguishable from the original renders.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们学习一个作用于每个高斯球谐（spherical-harmonic，SH）特征的小型、视角特定的噪声键，同时使所有其他视角与原始渲染保持一致、难以区分。

sentences.en: We further propose a Gradual Pixel Perturbation (GPP) strategy with a cosine-decay schedule, bootstrapping fast divergence from the clean render before transitioning to a combined reconstruction and SSIM loss.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出了一种采用余弦衰减调度的渐进像素扰动（Gradual Pixel Perturbation，GPP）策略，先从干净渲染快速引导出差异，再过渡到重构损失与 SSIM 损失的组合。

sentences.en: Unlike prior works that are highly dependent on accurate and large pretrained decoders, our method is able to recover the hidden image through rendering with noise key, and an optional lightweight refiner to enhance recovery image quality.
sentences.zh: 与高度依赖准确且大型预训练解码器的先前工作不同，我们的方法能够通过带噪声键的渲染来恢复隐藏图像，并可选用一个轻量级精修器来提升恢复图像的质量。

sentences.en: Across nine standard 3DGS data scenes, WhisperSplat demonstrates superior hidden image recovery quality without sacrifice in clean 3DGS model performance, when compared to prior work such as GS-Hider and KeySS.
sentences.zh: 在九个标准 3DGS 数据场景中，与 GS-Hider 和 KeySS 等先前工作相比，WhisperSplat 在不牺牲干净 3DGS 模型性能的情况下，展示了更优的隐藏图像恢复质量。

authors.name: Miao Yin
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Arlington

title_en: Who can we trust? LLM-as-a-jury for Comparative Assessment
title_zh: 我们能信任谁？用于比较评估的 LLM 陪审团

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied as automatic evaluators for natural language generation assessment often using pairwise comparative judgements.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自然语言生成评估的自动化评估器，通常采用成对比较判断。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically rely on single judges or aggregate multiple judges assuming equal reliability.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常依赖单一评判者，或是在假设可靠性相等的情况下聚合多个评判者。

sentences.en: In practice, LLM judges vary substantially in performance across tasks and aspects, and their judgment probabilities may be biased and inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，LLM 评判者在不同任务和维度上的表现差异显著，而且它们的判断概率可能有偏差且不一致。

sentences.en: Furthermore, human-labelled supervision for judge calibration may be unavailable.
sentences.zh: 此外，用于评判者校准的人工标注监督可能并不可用。

sentences.en: We first empirically demonstrate that inconsistencies in LLM comparison probabilities exist and show that it limits the effectiveness of direct probability-based ranking.
sentences.zh: 我们首先在实证上表明，LLM 比较概率中存在不一致性，并展示这限制了基于直接概率的排名的有效性。

sentences.en: To address this, we study the \emph{LLM-as-a-jury} setting and propose BT-$\sigma$, a judge-aware extension of the Bradley-Terry model that introduces a discriminator parameter for each judge to jointly infer item rankings and judge reliability from pairwise comparisons alone.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们研究了\emph{LLM 陪审团}（LLM-as-a-jury）设置，并提出了 BT-$\sigma$，这是 Bradley-Terry 模型的一种感知评判者的扩展，它为每个评判者引入一个判别参数，以便仅从成对比较中联合推断条目排名和评判者可靠性。

sentences.en: Experiments on benchmark NLG evaluation datasets show that \textit{BT-$\sigma$} consistently outperforms averaging-based aggregation methods, and that the learned discriminators strongly correlate with independent measures of the cycle consistency of LLM judgments.
sentences.zh: 在基准 NLG 评估数据集上的实验表明，\textit{BT-$\sigma$} 持续优于基于平均的聚合方法，并且学习到的判别器与 LLM 判断循环一致性的独立度量强相关。

sentences.en: Further analysis reveals that \textit{BT-$\sigma$} can be interpreted as an unsupervised calibration mechanism that improves aggregation by modelling judge reliability.
sentences.zh: 进一步分析表明，\textit{BT-$\sigma$} 可以被解释为一种无监督校准机制，它通过对评判者可靠性建模来改进聚合。

title_en: Who Evaluates AI's Social Impacts? Mapping Coverage and Gaps in First and Third Party Evaluations
title_zh: 谁来评估 AI 的社会影响？描绘第一方与第三方评估中的覆盖情况与空白

sentences.en: Foundation models are increasingly central to high-stakes AI systems, and governance frameworks now depend on evaluations to assess their risks and capabilities.
sentences.zh: 基础模型在高风险 AI 系统中越来越核心，治理框架如今依赖评估来审视它们的风险与能力。

sentences.en: Although general capability evaluations are widespread, social impact assessments covering bias, fairness, privacy, environmental costs, and labor remain uneven.
sentences.zh: 虽然一般性的能力评估已很普遍，但涵盖偏见、公平、隐私、环境成本和劳动的社会影响评估仍然参差不齐。

sentences.en: To characterize this landscape, we conduct the first comprehensive analysis of social impact evaluation reporting, examining 186 first-party release reports and 248 third-party evaluation sources, supplemented by developer interviews.
sentences.zh: 为刻画这一图景，我们对社会影响评估报告进行了首次全面分析，考察了 186 份第一方发布报告和 248 个第三方评估来源，并以开发者访谈作为补充。

sentences.en: We find a stark division of labor: first-party reporting is sparse, often superficial, and declining in areas like environmental impact and bias, while third-party evaluators provide broader, more rigorous coverage of bias, harmful content, and performance disparities.
sentences.zh: 我们发现一种鲜明的分工：第一方报告稀少、往往流于表面，并在环境影响和偏见等领域日益减少；而第三方评估者则在偏见、有害内容和性能差异方面提供了更广泛、更严谨的覆盖。

sentences.en: However, only developers can authoritatively report on data provenance, content moderation labor, costs, and infrastructure, yet interviews reveal these disclosures are deprioritized unless tied to product adoption or compliance.
sentences.zh: 然而，只有开发者才能权威地报告数据来源、内容审核人力、成本和基础设施，但访谈显示，除非与产品采用或合规相关，否则这些披露会被降级处理。

sentences.en: Current practices leave major gaps in assessing societal impacts, underscoring the need for policies that mandate developer transparency, strengthen independent evaluation ecosystems, and create shared infrastructure for aggregating third-party evaluations.
sentences.zh: 当前的做法在评估社会影响方面留下了重大空白，凸显了以下政策的必要性：强制要求开发者透明、加强独立评估生态、并建立用于汇集第三方评估的共享基础设施。

title_en: Who Gets Credit or Blame? Attributing Accountability in Modern AI Systems
title_zh: 谁获得赞誉或受到指责？现代 AI 系统中的责任归属

sentences.en: Modern AI systems are typically developed through multiple stages: pretraining, fine-tuning rounds, and subsequent adaptation or alignment, where each stage builds on the previous ones and updates the model in distinct ways.
sentences.zh: 现代 AI 系统通常通过多个阶段开发而成：预训练、多次微调轮次以及后续的适配或对齐，每个阶段都建立在前一阶段之上，并以不同的方式更新模型。

sentences.en: This raises a critical question of accountability: when a deployed model succeeds or fails, which stage is responsible, and to what extent?
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个关于责任归属的关键问题：当一个已部署的模型成功或失败时，哪一个阶段应负责任，以及责任程度有多大？

sentences.en: We pose the accountability attribution problem for tracing model behavior back to specific stages of the model development process.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了责任归属（accountability attribution）问题，旨在将模型行为追溯到模型开发过程中的特定阶段。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a general framework that answers counterfactual questions about stage effects: how would the model's behavior have changed if the updates from a particular stage had not occurred?
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个通用框架，回答关于阶段影响的因果反事实问题：如果特定阶段的更新没有发生，模型的行为将会如何改变？

sentences.en: Within this framework, we introduce estimators that efficiently quantify stage effects without retraining the model, accounting for both the data and key aspects of model optimization dynamics, including learning rate schedules, momentum, and weight decay.
sentences.zh: 在该框架内，我们引入了一些估计器，无需重新训练模型即可高效量化阶段影响，同时兼顾数据以及模型优化动态的关键方面，包括学习率调度、动量（momentum）和权重衰减（weight decay）。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that our approach successfully quantifies the accountability of each stage to the model's behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，我们的方法能够成功量化每个阶段对模型行为的责任。

sentences.en: Based on the attribution results, our method can identify stages associated with spurious correlations in image classification and text toxicity detection tasks and guide targeted follow-up interventions.
sentences.zh: 基于归属结果，我们的方法能够识别图像分类和文本有害性检测任务中与虚假相关性（spurious correlations）相关的阶段，并指导有针对性的后续干预。

sentences.en: Our approach provides a practical tool for model analysis and represents a significant step toward more accountable AI development.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法为模型分析提供了一个实用工具，也是朝着更具责任感的 AI 开发迈出的重要一步。

authors.name: Hongzhe Du
authors.institution: UCLA Computer Science Department, University of California, Los Angeles

title_en: Who Said Neural Networks Aren't Linear?
title_zh: 谁说神经网络不是线性的？

sentences.en: Neural networks are famously nonlinear.
sentences.zh: 神经网络是出了名的非线性系统。

sentences.en: However, linearity is defined relative to a pair of vector spaces, $f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{Y}$.
sentences.zh: 然而，线性是相对于一对向量空间 $f:\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{Y}$ 来定义的。

sentences.en: Leveraging the algebraic concept of transport of structure, we propose a method to explicitly identify non-standard vector spaces where a neural network acts as a linear operator.
sentences.zh: 借助结构传输（transport of structure）这一代数概念，我们提出了一种方法，用于显式识别神经网络作为线性算子作用的非标准向量空间。

sentences.en: When sandwiching a linear operator $A$ between two invertible neural networks, $f(x)=g_y^{-1}(A g_x(x))$, the corresponding vector spaces $\mathcal{X}$ and $\mathcal{Y}$ are induced by newly defined addition and scaling actions derived from $g_x$ and $g_y$.
sentences.zh: 当在一个线性算子 $A$ 的两侧夹上两个可逆神经网络，即 $f(x)=g_y^{-1}(A g_x(x))$ 时，相应的向量空间 $\mathcal{X}$ 和 $\mathcal{Y}$ 由源自 $g_x$ 和 $g_y$ 的新定义的加法与缩放作用所诱导。

sentences.en: We term this kind of architecture a Linearizer.
sentences.zh: 我们将这类架构称为 Linearizer（线性化器）。

sentences.en: This framework makes the entire arsenal of linear algebra, including SVD, pseudo-inverse, orthogonal projection and more, applicable to nonlinear mappings.
sentences.zh: 该框架使线性代数的全部工具，包括 SVD、伪逆（pseudo-inverse）、正交投影等等，都能应用于非线性映射。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that the composition of two Linearizers that share a neural network is also a Linearizer.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明，共享一个神经网络的两个 Linearizer 的复合仍然是 Linearizer。

sentences.en: We leverage this property and demonstrate that training diffusion models using our architecture makes the hundreds of sampling steps collapse into a single step.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一性质证明，使用我们的架构训练扩散模型，可以使数百步采样步骤压缩为单步采样。

sentences.en: We further utilize our framework to enforce idempotency (i.e.\ $f(f(x))=f(x)$) on networks leading to a globally projective generative model and to demonstrate modular style transfer.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步利用该框架在网络中施加幂等性（即 $f(f(x))=f(x)$），从而得到一个全局投影式的生成模型，并演示模块化的风格迁移。

title_en: Who Transfers Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Neurons
title_zh: 谁在迁移安全性？识别并定位跨语言共享的安全神经元

sentences.en: Multilingual safety remains significantly imbalanced, leaving non-high-resource (NHR) languages vulnerable compared to robust high-resource (HR) ones.
sentences.zh: 多语言安全性仍然严重不平衡，与稳健的高资源（HR）语言相比，非高资源（NHR）语言更加脆弱。

sentences.en: Moreover, the neural mechanisms driving safety alignment remain unclear despite observed cross-lingual representation transfer.
sentences.zh: 此外，尽管观察到了跨语言表征迁移，但驱动安全对齐的神经机制仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this paper, we find that LLMs contain a set of cross-lingual shared safety neurons (SS-Neurons), a remarkably small yet critical neuronal subset that jointly regulates safety behavior across languages.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们发现大语言模型（LLM）包含一组跨语言共享的安全神经元（SS-Neuron），这是一个极小却关键的神经元子集，共同调控跨语言的安全行为。

sentences.en: We first identify monolingual safety neurons (MS-Neurons) and validate their causal role in safety refusal behavior through targeted activation and suppression.
sentences.zh: 我们首先识别出单语言安全神经元（MS-Neuron），并通过有针对性的激活与抑制实验验证它们在安全拒答行为中的因果作用。

sentences.en: Our cross-lingual analyses then identify SS-Neurons as the subset of MS-Neurons shared between HR and NHR languages, serving as a bridge to transfer safety capabilities from HR to NHR domains.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们的跨语言分析将 SS-Neuron 确定为 HR 与 NHR 语言之间共有的 MS-Neuron 子集，它充当将安全能力从 HR 领域迁移到 NHR 领域的桥梁。

sentences.en: We observe that suppressing these neurons causes concurrent safety drops across NHR languages, whereas reinforcing them improves cross-lingual defensive consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，抑制这些神经元会导致 NHR 各语言的安全性同步下降，而强化它们则会提高跨语言的防御一致性。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we propose a simple neuron-oriented training strategy that targets SS-Neurons based on language resource distribution and model architecture.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们提出了一种简单的面向神经元的训练策略，根据语言资源分布与模型架构对 SS-Neuron 进行靶向处理。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning this tiny neuronal subset outperforms state-of-the-art methods, significantly enhancing NHR safety while maintaining the model's general capabilities.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，对这一微小神经元子集进行微调优于现有最先进的方法，在显著提升 NHR 安全性的同时保持了模型的通用能力。

title_en: Whom to Query for What: Adaptive Group Elicitation via Multi-Turn LLM Interactions
title_zh: 向谁询问什么：通过多轮 LLM 交互进行自适应群体信息获取

sentences.en: Eliciting information to reduce uncertainty about latent group-level properties is a central problem in collective assessment, preference modeling, and opinion aggregation, and is especially important in survey-based studies.
sentences.zh: 通过信息获取来降低关于潜在群体层面属性的不确定性，是集体评估、偏好建模与意见聚合中的核心问题，在基于问卷的研究中尤为重要。

sentences.en: While natural language interactions provide a flexible interface, existing methods typically rely on fixed questionnaires and static respondent sets, and do not adapt to partial or missing responses across rounds.
sentences.zh: 尽管自然语言交互提供了灵活的界面，但现有方法通常依赖固定问卷和静态受访者集合，无法适应各轮之间的部分或缺失回答。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we study adaptive information elicitation through multi-turn interactions between a large language model and a group of individuals, where both queries and respondents are adaptively selected to infer latent group properties.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们研究通过大语言模型与一组个体之间的多轮交互来进行自适应信息获取，其中查询问题和受访者都被自适应地选择，以推断潜在的群体属性。

sentences.en: We propose a theoretically grounded framework that, at each round, jointly selects a query and a subset of respondents based on previously observed responses to efficiently reduce uncertainty about a target latent quantity (e.g., group-level political inclination).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个基于理论框架，在每一轮中根据先前观察到的回答联合选择一个问题和一个受访者子集，从而高效降低关于目标潜在量（如群体层面的政治倾向）的不确定性。

sentences.en: Motivated by practical survey constraints, such as limited questions and costly participation, our strategy maximizes information gain under a fixed budget.
sentences.zh: 受实际问卷约束（如问题数量有限、参与成本高昂）的启发，我们的策略在固定预算下最大化信息增益。

sentences.en: To handle missing and incomplete responses, we combine graph neural networks for aggregating/imputing partial group information with an information-theoretic criterion that guides per-round selection.
sentences.zh: 为处理缺失和不完整的回答，我们将用于聚合/填补部分群体信息的图神经网络与一个信息论准则相结合，以指导每一轮的选取。

sentences.en: Across three real-world opinion datasets, we achieve consistent improvements in population-level response prediction under constrained budgets, including over a 12% relative gain on CES at a 10% respondent budget.
sentences.zh: 在三个真实世界意见数据集上，我们在受限预算下持续提升了总体层面的回答预测效果，其中包括在仅 10% 受访者预算下于 CES 上取得超过 12% 的相对提升。
